result.title: Looking Ahead and Back: Anticipatory Generative Modeling for Road-Network Trajectories
result.summary: Trajectory generation underpins urban applications such as traffic management and urban planning. Within road networks, vehicle movement along road segments is largely deterministic, whereas transitions at intersections are critical--multiple outgoing paths may appear equally plausible, yet they can lead to substantially different downstream routes. Existing generative methods such as diffusion models simulate location sequences and fail short of next transition selection, even producing trajectories that drift off the road network. To fill this gap, we advocate a fundamental shift: moving beyond location simulation toward behavior modeling on the road network. In this paper, we revisit trajectory generation through the lens of generative route planning, and introduce a new graph-constrained generative paradigm, Anticipatory Generative Modeling, which resolves next transition selection by incorporating the Anticipation of how the future route may unfold toward the destination. Concretely, we propose a novel generative model named Foresight that formulates a probabilistic model for an "anticipate--select--update--re-anticipate" loop that enables longer-term foresight while continuing sequential generation along the historical trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Foresight wins state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究路网轨迹生成，主张从位置模拟转向路网上的行为建模，提出图约束的 Anticipatory Generative Modeling 与 Foresight 模型，用「anticipate–select–update–re-anticipate」循环在路口完成下一步转移选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其循环式状态更新与「多个出边同样合理、需择优」的多候选选择机制，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态迭代更新与多假设筛选提供可核查的方法线索，但对象是路网轨迹而非视觉推理，迁移属推测。
